brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 pieces: piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full arranged linearly with bend

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 starts at -1,0,0 entryEdge 3 through 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 1,1,0, passing through all 4 cells. meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Planter bins in each cell (to make it a functional planter)
requirements.evidence: Only 2 of 4 planter bins placed: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-third-pi and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-third-pi. Bins at 0,0,0 and 1,1,0 refused MESH_CLASH with pvc-coupling (1.875mm overlap) due to pipe couplings intersecting pi bin geometry.

finish.summary: Built 4-cell cluster with continuous water run through every base (verified meshClash clear). Planter function partial: 2 pi-bins placed, 2 cells remain without bins due to coupling clash on this nonlinear 4-cell route.

lines.key: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 143 mm over 1 corner
lines.label: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 143 mm over 1 corner

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
buy 1 x 25 ft 3/4 in FLEXIBLE PVC, IPS, OD 26.67 mm (US), glues into Sch 40 sockets
- flexible legs are pool/spa grade hose: irrigation only, NOT potable and not for indoor plumbing
- glue with Weld-On 795 flexible-PVC cement and P-68/P-70 primer, not ordinary rigid cement
- keep every bend clear of its glued socket: the joint fails long before the pipe does
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
